dct_description_sm: THIS IS A GEOREFERENCED FILE. Victoria Harbour, Vancouver Island; surveyed by Henry Kellett, Capt RN, 1847. Admiralty Chart 1897. 1.2 cables to one inch. Admiralty. J. & C. Walker, Sculpt.[Victoria, 1848]. At head of title: America N.W. Coast Vancouver Island. Soundings in feet. Compass rose. Relief shown by hachures. Shows location of Fort Victoria.
